status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, ELECTRAC LIMITED (Company number NI636315, formerly S Black Electrac NI Limited) is currently active and lists one individual person with significant control.

claims.claim: The company reports supplying and installing custom-configured fleet telematics, 360-degree live-streaming CCTV systems, blind-spot and proximity sensors, pedestrian detection systems, and park brake safety systems that integrate straight into vehicles and mechanical assets.
Elec Trac NI maintains a partnership with Lease Group Limited to provide customer financing options for hardware installations.
The company reports an ongoing collaborative technology integration with FastView 360 IRL to deliver vehicle CCTV and AI-driven camera systems.
Electrac NI reports its main operational facility at 223 Moira Road, Lisburn, Northern Ireland, from which it provides hands-on consultation, fleet safety audits, and custom engineering support.
Independent business tracking data verified that Electrac NI operates as a small-scale regional provider with a headcount of approximately 3 employees.
claims.note: The precise employee count of exactly 3 is unverified; public tracking profiles list a broader range of 2-10 employees.

status.evidence: According to Companies House records, Fleeta Limited (company number 16675897) is an active private limited company incorporated on 27 August 2025 with its registered office in Ipswich.

claims.claim: Customer reviews from May 2026 verify that Fleeta Limited’s Fleetalyse platform actively integrates and deploys Teltonika FMC003 and FMC920 hardware devices alongside its Brilliant Tracker software for live tracking and remote tachograph data downloads.
claims.note: customer reviews from May 2026 and "Brilliant Tracker software" details could not be verified

claims.claim: The company reports in its official product logs from May 2026 that it prepares and ships Teltonika FMC650 devices to support fleet tracking upgrades, system migrations, and rapid field deployment across Europe.
claims.source: Vytautas Pipiras' official LinkedIn updates for Fleetalyse (2026)

claims.claim: The company's Fleetalyse brand delivers live GPS vehicle tracking, journey history, real-time alerts, driver behavior analytics, and remote tachograph downloads on a unified cloud interface.

The company reports that its FLEETA platform operates directly via BlackVue dashcam hardware, featuring a 3-axis acceleration sensor, built-in GPS/GLONASS, and optional external LTE modules to transmit cloud footage without traditional multi-year complex hardware agreements.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its FLEETA platform operates directly via BlackVue dashcam hardware, featuring a 3-axis acceleration sensor, built-in GPS/GLONASS, and optional external LTE modules to transmit cloud footage without traditional multi-year complex hardware agreements.
claims.note: FLEETA is a dedicated platform by BlackVue (Pittasoft) itself, completely distinct from Fleeta Limited of Ipswich, UK, which operates Fleetalyse and Logivo.ai. Therefore, the company (Fleeta Limited) does not report this platform or setup.

claims.claim: The company's Fleetalyse brand retails unlocked, standard third-party hardware such as the Teltonika FMC920 4G LTE GPS tracker, allowing commercial transport operators to complete a standard wired vehicle integration.

The company reports that its developer platform isolation model is designed to satisfy the ISO/IEC 27001 access control (A.9) requirements by enforcing tenant boundaries in a fail-closed shared authentication layer, as documented by the Fleeta Developers Portal.
claims.note: The entire statement regarding the developer platform isolation model, ISO/IEC 27001 requirements, tenant boundaries, and fail-closed authentication layer is unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The company reports that traffic is encrypted in transit using mandatory TLS (HTTPS), API keys are stored only as SHA-256 hashes, and OAuth access tokens are sealed with AES-256-GCM encryption, according to the official Fleeta Developers Privacy Policy.
claims.note: Specific details about SHA-256 API key hashing and AES-256-GCM token encryption are unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Fleetalyse, a B2B fleet tracking platform operated by Fleeta Limited, provides an open Developer API that supports live and historical tracking data in a single consolidated format across 613 GPS tracker and telematics device models from 84 different manufacturers.

Fleeta Limited operates commercial fleet platforms including Fleetalyse (live GPS trackers and fleet technology) and OperatorCompliance.co.uk (operator licence compliance software), offering services such as a provider membership plan priced at £10 per month plus VAT.
claims.corrected: Fleeta Limited operates commercial fleet platforms including Fleetalyse (live GPS trackers and fleet technology) and OperatorCompliance.co.uk (operator licence compliance software), offering services such as a Starter subscription plan priced at £90 billed yearly.

claims.claim: Fleetalyse Business Details confirms Fleeta Limited operates its registered office at 50 Princes Street, Ipswich, and an additional commercial vehicle workshop location at Bridge Farm, Woolpit.
